## One Dark

A clean, focused dark theme inspired by Atom's iconic One Dark color scheme. Neutral cool-toned backgrounds with a distinctive blue accent create a productive, distraction-free interface.

### Highlights

- **Blue accent (#61afef)** — the signature One Dark blue
- **Cool neutral surfaces** — #282c34 editor background, no blue tint
- **System fonts** — no custom font download required

### Usage

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/one-dark.css">
```
